metadata.title: आदिवासी नेताओं को निशाना बनाने वालों को हराने का नारा | Adivasi Ekta Rally Moharabadi
metadata.description: In response to the recent de-listing of RSS-affiliated organisation Adivasi Suraksha Manch, Adivasi Ekta Maharally was organised on February 4, 2024. A large number of people from the tribal community participated in this Maharally organised by Jharkhand Jan Adhikar Manch at Morhabadi Maidan in Ranchi. The issue of the arrest of former CM Hemant Soren dominated the rally. The speakers in the rally said that a tribal Chief Minister had been implicated in a conspiracy. Therefore, the tribal society should answer this unitedly in the 2024 Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. National President of Tribal Congress, Shivaji Rao Voge and the Working President of Congress addressed the rally.
